svg.title: How Ordnung handles a letter
svg.desc: How Ordnung handles a letter, in four steps. Your letters: a PDF, a phone photo, an e-mail or a watched folder. Claude reads them (the model), in your own Claude Code with no tools, and answers in JSON; it never computes a date. Ordnung’s code computes (tested, deterministic): it finds each quote on the page and works out each date and its receipt with the rules engine. You decide, in the web app, the CLI or on your phone; Ask is Claude again, on read-only MCP tools, with every value checked before you see it.
